title: Turn Claude into a content engine (11 prompts)
caption: I shipped 13 articles in a week using Claude. The exact 11 prompts I rotate through — no fluff, paste-ready. Comment BUILD and I'll DM you the full pack.

slides.sub: The exact prompts I rotate through. Paste-ready.

slides.title: Scrape the angle
slides.body: Feed Claude one viral carousel from your niche. Ask: "Extract the hook, the body density curve, and the CTA mechanic. Output as a one-page brief I can riff on."

slides.title: The hook generator
slides.code:
You are a viral-hook writer.
Given a topic, output 10 hooks.

Rules:
- Each hook <= 12 words
- Half contrarian, half curiosity-gap
- One must include a specific number
- Mark the strongest 3 with [*]

slides.title: Body density curve
slides.body: Carousels die when slide 3 has 80 words and slide 6 has 12. Ask Claude to plot density per slide and rebalance — tight middle, lean ends.
